title: Two circuits, one bundle
about: Scenes for the Story-FGT-SDWAN fabric. Cables are named 'Device:port' exactly as Fabric Studio shows them. Only cables listed here can ever be broken or repaired by story-runner.

scenes.title: Cut the broadband circuit
scenes.blurb: Someone backs a truck into the demarc. The FortiGate's WAN1 port goes dark.

scenes.title: Cut the cellular circuit
scenes.blurb: The cellular modem dies. WAN2's port goes dark.

scenes.title: Broadband ISP upstream outage
scenes.blurb: The cable is fine and the modem lights are green, but the ISP's core is down. Only the SLA probes notice.

scenes.title: Cellular carrier outage
scenes.blurb: The carrier's core drops. WAN2 stays up locally but goes nowhere.
